# Ordinance No. 06, Series of 2008

**Reclassifying Agricultural Land to Commercial Land**

## Summary

This ordinance reclassifies the agricultural land owned by Mr. [[Paulino S. Sayat]] in Brgy. Nag-Cruz, Pitogo, Quezon, with Transfer Certificate of Title T 322048 and a total area of 19,554 sq. meters, to commercial land for use as a memorial park/cemetery. The ordinance mandates the owner/developer to pay the necessary fees and charges to the Municipal Treasurer. It takes effect ten (10) days after its publication upon approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** An agricultural land owned by Mr. [[Paulino S. Sayat]] located at Brgy. Nag-Cruz, Pitogo, Quezon with Transfer Certificate of Title T 322048 and a total area of 19,554 sq. meters to be reclassified to a commercial land (Memorial Park/Cemetery).
2.  **Section 2.** The owner/developer will pay to the Municipal Treasurer the necessary fees and charges before the issuance of Resolution/Certificate.
3.  **Section 3.** This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its publication upon approval.
